title: 雪山隧道工程
summary: 認識複雜地質、地下水、開挖支護與營運安全如何共同決定長隧道工程。
summaryEn: Learn how complex geology, groundwater, excavation support and operational safety shape long tunnels.
scope: 公開原理的分層工程教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務，並非原廠配方、施工圖或操作許可。
scopeEn: A layered course in public engineering principles. Steps are verifiable learning tasks, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, or operating authorization.

knowledge.textEn: Alignment balances terrain, transport links and geological risk.
